tagline: The lower-Gulf triangle's middle island — Samui's closest high-frequency hop.
summary: Koh Phangan sits between Koh Samui and Koh Tao in the lower-Gulf island triangle, ~12 nm from Samui. It carries relentless onward flow from the 1.13M+ annual Samui arrivals — a high-frequency, short Pioneer II hop on a route run today by crowded diesel ferries and speedboats.

seasonality: Peak: Dec-Apr; SW monsoon brings rougher Gulf crossings. Foiling extends comfort.
